description:
Elixir's TryClauseError message is "no try clause matching:

    <inspect value>
" and MatchError, CaseClauseError, WithClauseError, FunctionClauseError (once fz-sc8.64 names them) all embed Exception.format/inspect renderings of a value. fz-3ul.2 built TryClauseError with the struct fields Elixir has (term, message) but the message stops at the colon because fz has no inspect primitive; fixture 00733 pins Elixir's full banner in expected.txt and fz's shorter line in expected.stderr. Once fz-sc8.10 (inspect/1,2) lands, the message is built with it and the uncaught line matches Elixir's banner.

Acceptance: 00733's expected.stderr equals Elixir's banner text (first line plus indented value); the same for every library exception whose message embeds a value, found by grep over lib/*.fz for message strings that end at a colon; oracle fixtures on interp, run and build; .agent/docs/exceptions.md 'The line' updated; gate green.
title: An exception message that embeds a value renders it with inspect
